title: File:Kiosco en el centro de Tepoztlán..JPG

ObjectName.value: Kiosco en el centro de Tepoztlán.

Categories.value: Tepoztlán|Self-published work|Bandstands in Morelos|Tepoztlán en la Mirada project|Octagonal bandstands in Mexico

ImageDescription.value: In the photo we can see the kiosk located in the center of the tourist town Tepoztlan, Morelos, Mexico. The kiosk is white with red and black rail. It has a red octagonal roof, on top of it as a movable arrow indicating the wind direction. At the bottom of the kiosk there are posters pasted with photos of the 43 missing in Ayotzinapa in Iguala, Guerrero on November 2014.
